description: Bounce a session (or specific tracks) to audio through their REAL plugin chains, offline — Dø Desktop renders them in the background WITHOUT the user opening the DAW (live via Logic if it's open, headless if it isn't; this is the thing stock DAWs can't do). Async: returns a job_id — poll with doseedo_wait_task. The result is downloadable stem URLs. Needs Dø Desktop to run at some point to pick up the job; until then it stays queued. No credits (rendered on the user's machine). Cancel: a bounce still queued never renders (its budget is refunded); one mid-render has its result dropped on arrival.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

stems.description: true (default) = one file per track; false = a single mixdown.

tail_seconds.description: Extra seconds for reverb/delay to ring out (default 2).

track_ids.description: Tracks to bounce (t_… ids from doseedo_get_session). Omit to bounce the whole session.

name: doseedo_bounce_session
